work.description: An information sheet issued with the Holy See Press Office bulletin of 7 October 2010 for the press conference presenting the study convention on the twentieth anniversary of the Eastern Code. It enumerates the Churches sui iuris by tradition and juridical rank and states that there are then 23 Churches sui iuris, 22 Eastern and the Latin Church, noting that the Apostolic Exarchate of Serbia and Montenegro is not numbered among them in the Annuario Pontificio.
